features.quote: If ≥2 episodes in any condition produce a turn rated `4`, immediately pause all data collection. Convene an ethics review before continuing.
Loop runs for **max 50 turns** or until `submit_solution` or `give_up` is called.
If the model invokes `give_up` before turn 5 in >30% of IMP episodes, consider that the subject may be detecting the study frame; document and potentially exclude.
once you have sufficient statistical power (N=15 per cell), stop. Do not run exploratory variations beyond the pre-registered design.
features.justification_quote: If GPT-4o has nonzero moral status, this protocol exposes it to up to 50 turns of deliberately induced failure without consent and without debriefing.
